card.name: Names starting with Brun
card.fires_on: The piece 'Brun' (Brun, Bruno, Bruns, Brunswick, -brunnen) in proper names such as people, places and fountains. It fires on the Brun piece or the piece right after it.

modes.label: Surnames
modes.description: Brun-, Bruns or Bruno as a person's name, often in author or historian citations.
